change_summary: The retraction alert is about a different article, 'Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses'. Its notice says the data could not be verified. The tracked paper on exam anxiety in undergraduates has no notice of its own, so nothing here affects what you can rely on from it. The notice's update-to list does include the tracked paper, so you may want to check that metadata link.
